patthana10.11:10.1: pahātabbaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nadassanenapahātabbahetukattika nahetudukaṃ na dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca … na neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... naācayagāmittika nahetudukaṃ na ācayagāmiṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na apacayagāmiṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana10.11:12.1: nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na sekkhattika nahetudukaṃ na sekkhaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na asekkhaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na
patthana10.11:13.1: nevasekkhānāsekkhaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... naparittattika nahetudukaṃ na parittaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na mahaggataṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na
patthana10.11:14.1: appamāṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... naparittārammaṇattika nahetudukaṃ na parittārammaṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na mahaggatārammaṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana10.11:16.1: appamāṇārammaṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nahīnattika nahetudukaṃ na hīnaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na majjhimaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na
patthana10.11:17.1: paṇītaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... namicchattattika nahetudukaṃ na micchattaniyataṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na sammattaniyataṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana10.11:19.1: aniyataṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... namaggārammaṇattika nahetudukaṃ na maggārammaṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na maggahetukaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana10.11:21.1: maggādhipatiṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nauppannattika nahetudukaṃ na anuppannaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na uppādiṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... naatītattika nahetudukaṃ na
patthana10.11:22.1: atītaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na anāgataṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... naatītārammaṇattika nahetudukaṃ na
patthana10.11:23.1: atītārammaṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na anāgatārammaṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na
patthana10.11:24.1: paccuppannārammaṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... naajjhattattika nahetudukaṃ na ajjhattaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na bahiddhā na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... naajjhattārammaṇattika nahetudukaṃ na
patthana10.11:25.1: ajjhattārammaṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na bahiddhārammaṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nasanidassanattika nahetudukaṃ na
patthana10.11:26.1: sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na hetu
